sql.customField.getOne: select cf.id, cf.list_of_value_id, cf.company_id, cf.field_name, cf.archived, cf.created_by_id, cf.modified_by_id, cf.company_data_type_id, cf.custom_field_sql_key_id, cfsk.sql_key as "custom_field_sql_key", coalesce(( select array_to_json(array_agg(rows)) from ( select ot.id as "objectTypeId", ot.object_type as "objectType", cfot.id, cfot.custom_field_id as "customFieldId", cfot.archived from flow.object_type ot left join flow.custom_field_object_type cfot on cfot.object_type_id = ot.id and cfot.custom_field_id = cf.id ) rows), '[]') AS custom_field_object_types, coalesce(( select array_to_json(array_agg(rows)) from ( select lv.id, lv.name, lv.parent_id as "parentId", lv.date_created as "dateCreated", lv.date_modified as "dateModified", lv.created_by_id as "createdById", lv.modified_by_id as "modifiedById", lv.archived from flow.list_of_value lv where lv.parent_id = cf.list_of_value_id and lv.archived is not true order by lv.display_order ) rows), '[]') AS list_of_values from flow.custom_field cf left join flow.custom_field_sql_key cfsk on cfsk.id = cf.custom_field_sql_key_id where cf.id = :id order by cf.field_name
sql.customField.getAll: select cf.id, cf.list_of_value_id, cf.company_id, cf.field_name, cf.archived, cf.created_by_id, cf.modified_by_id, cf.company_data_type_id, cf.custom_field_sql_key_id, cfsk.sql_key as "custom_field_sql_key", coalesce(( select array_to_json(array_agg(rows)) from ( select ot.id as "objectTypeId", ot.object_type as "objectType", cfot.id, cfot.custom_field_id as "customFieldId", cfot.archived from flow.object_type ot left join flow.custom_field_object_type cfot on cfot.object_type_id = ot.id and cfot.custom_field_id = cf.id ) rows), '[]') AS custom_field_object_types, coalesce(( select array_to_json(array_agg(rows)) from ( select lv.id, lv.name, lv.parent_id as "parentId", lv.date_created as "dateCreated", lv.date_modified as "dateModified", lv.created_by_id as "createdById", lv.modified_by_id as "modifiedById", lv.display_order as "displayOrder", lv.archived from flow.list_of_value lv where lv.parent_id = cf.list_of_value_id and lv.archived is not true order by lv.display_order ) rows), '[]') AS list_of_values from flow.custom_field cf left join flow.custom_field_sql_key cfsk on cfsk.id = cf.custom_field_sql_key_id where cf.company_id = :companyId and cf.archived is not true order by cf.field_name
sql.customField.getObjectTypes: select * from flow.object_type where company_id = :companyId and archived is not true
sql.customField.deleteField: update flow.custom_field set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :fieldId
sql.customField.saveField: update flow.custom_field set field_name = :fieldName, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.customField.insertField: insert into flow.custom_field(list_of_value_id, company_id, field_name, date_created, created_by_id, company_data_type_id, custom_field_sql_key_id) values (:listOfValueId, :companyId, :fieldName, now(), :createdById, :companyDataTypeId, :customFieldSqlKeyId) returning id
sql.customField.insertListOfValue: insert into flow.list_of_value(name, parent_id, date_created, created_by_id, display_order) values (:name, :parentId, now(), :createdById, :displayOrder)
sql.customField.updateListOfValue: update flow.list_of_value set name = :name, parent_id = :parentId, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, display_order = :displayOrder, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.customField.archiveListOfValue: update flow.list_of_value set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.customField.updateSqlKey: update flow.custom_field_sql_key set sql_key = :customFieldSqlKey where id = :customFieldSqlKeyId
sql.customField.updateCustomFieldObjectType: update flow.custom_field_object_type set archived = :archived where id = :id
sql.customField.getByParentProcessStep: select cf.*, cfga.id as custom_field_group_assignment_id from flow.process_step ps inner join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfg.process_step_id = ps.id inner join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on cfga.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga.custom_field_id where ps.id = :id and cfga.ancillary_custom_field_group_assignment_id is null order by cf.field_name
